title: Sending a compliance question streams a response with rendered blocks, citations, and follow-up chips
description: Full path: page.jsx streamRealAPI() -> aiAssistantService.sendChatMessageStream() -> POST /api/assistant/chat/stream (SSE) -> assistant-service chat.routes.ts pipes python-ai's blocks/content/followups/done events back to the browser.
preconditions: Logged in as a seeded user with a project selected
steps: Type 'Show compliance status across all frameworks' and press Enter
Observe the 'analyzing/fetching' progress indicator, then the streamed narrative typing in word-by-word
Wait for the response to finish
expectedResult: A stat_tiles/table/donut block renders deterministically (not model-generated), narrative text appears via BlockRenderer's markdown block, citations (if any) are attached to the message, and 2-4 suggested follow-up question chips appear below the response.

title: Switching the active project mid-session clears the chat and starts a fresh, project-scoped conversation
description: page.jsx's project-change effect clears sessionStorage (CHAT_SESSION_KEY), resets conversationId to null, and replaces messages with a 'Project switched!' prompt — conversations are project-scoped and must never continue silently under a different project's context.
preconditions: User has an active conversation under Project A
User is also a member of Project B
steps: On /assistant, send a message and receive a response under Project A
Use the project selector (Navbar) to switch to Project B without navigating away
expectedResult: The chat pane clears and shows 'Project switched! How can I help with this project?' with fresh quick actions. No message from the Project A conversation remains visible, and conversationId is reset (a new message starts a brand-new thread scoped to Project B).

title: Logging out and a different user logging in on the same tab never shows the previous user's chat
description: sessionStorage is scoped to the browser tab, not the login session, so a shared-machine logout/login previously left the first user's compliance conversation rendered for the second. The v3 session blob is stamped with userId; page.jsx's ownership-validation effect discards it on mismatch.
preconditions: User A has an active /assistant conversation with visible messages
User B is a different member of the same organization
steps: As User A, send at least one message on /assistant and confirm it renders
Log out (without closing the tab) and log in as User B in the same tab
expectedResult: User B sees a fresh welcome message, not User A's conversation. sessionStorage's vibrantix_assistant_chat_session entry is cleared/replaced, and no network call is made using User A's stale conversationId.

title: Clicking a suggested follow-up question chip submits it and produces a new streamed response
preconditions: A prior response rendered at least one suggested follow-up chip
steps: Send an initial query that returns follow-up suggestion chips
Click one of the suggestion chips
expectedResult: The chip's text is submitted as a new user message (visible in the transcript) and a new streamed AI response begins, without requiring the user to retype anything into the composer.

title: Stop button aborts an in-flight stream and offers a Retry action, without losing the user's original message
description: handleStop() aborts the AbortController; sendChatMessageStream() treats the resulting AbortError as a user-initiated cancel (not an error toast) and keeps whatever narrative had streamed so far.
preconditions: A response is actively streaming (narrative visibly typing in)
steps: Send a query that produces a long streamed response
While the response is still streaming, click the Stop button
expectedResult: Streaming halts immediately; the assistant bubble shows 'Response stopped.' with a Retry option that resubmits the original query; no 'Service error' toast is shown for a user-initiated stop.

title: Renaming and deleting a conversation from the History tab updates the sidebar immediately
preconditions: At least 2 saved conversations exist for the current project
steps: Open the History tab in the assistant sidebar
Rename a conversation via the inline edit control and confirm
Delete a different conversation and confirm the browser confirm() dialog
expectedResult: The renamed title reflects immediately in the sidebar list (optimistic update) without a full history reload. The deleted conversation disappears from the list; if it was the active conversation, the chat pane resets to a new conversation.

title: Evidence Preview panel renders full metadata, mapped controls, and audit history for an evidence item surfaced by the assistant
description: EvidencePreviewModal.jsx renders Details/Content/Controls/History tabs from the evidence object passed in. Its audit history falls back to a synthesised 2-entry timeline ('Status changed to X' / 'Evidence uploaded') when evidence.auditHistory is not supplied by the caller — verify which case is actually wired for assistant-surfaced evidence.
preconditions: An assistant response includes at least one expandable_items entry of type 'evidence'
steps: Ask the assistant a query that returns evidence items (e.g. 'List evidence items and their control mapping status')
Open the evidence preview for one returned item
Check the Details, Content, Controls, and History tabs
expectedResult: Details tab shows correct id/category/date/uploadedBy/framework matching the source evidence record. History tab shows either the real audit trail for that evidence item or, if unavailable, a clearly generic 2-entry placeholder — confirm which, and flag if the placeholder is shown for evidence that does have real history (misleading audit trail).
